release: Trademinator M4 completion and M4.1 cross-exchange lead/lag R1
revision_summary: Configure the complete test suite's 512 MiB memory budget so a 128 MiB CLI default does not cause a database fetch fatal.
delivery: Full application source with compiled frontend assets; preserves existing deployment data.
not_exercised: Live exchange data or real-market predictive performance
MariaDB production migration and multi-host execution
notes: Rebuild M4 models after migration: the corrected pattern validation protocol invalidates old signal models, while retaining their reports.
Preserves M4 readiness and automatic successful-backfill feature/model rebuilds from main 31e7271.
Daily lead/lag dispatch uses the existing intelligence queue; no additional system cron or daemon.
Matching spot symbols, quote currencies and selected fixed periods only; no sub-candle timing claims.
Country metadata is context, not proof of trader geography; ambiguous timezone priors use UTC/unknown until an operator override.
New lead/lag relationships must pass chronological selection, final validation, direction and persistence gates before affecting KNN.
No dependencies changed. No client trading, M5 API or billing changes.
